enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over body. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain motionless. Move arm under pillow. Turn onto back. Adjust blanket. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Keep eyes closed.

Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from glass. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Check schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to nurse station. Answer phone. Schedule appointment. Walk to patient room. Discharge patient. Clean equipment. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang coat. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Heat pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir fry. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner with fork. Drink water. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out beer. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink beer. Watch TV.

Gather dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press start button. Wait for wash cycle. Open washing machine. Transfer clothes to dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button. Wait for dry cycle. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Place clothes in basket. Carry basket to bedroom. Put clothes in wardrobe. Return to living room.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch movie. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Eat snack. Resume movie. Turn off computer. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body.

Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over body. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain motionless. Move arm under pillow. Turn onto back. Adjust blanket. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Keep eyes closed.
